# Sumanta Mukhopadhyay

> Fractional CTO, principal engineer and AI architect based in the United States and the UAE. Ontology and knowledge graphs, production RAG and agentic AI, private LLMs, healthcare data (FHIR, OMOP, HIPAA), scalable data platforms (1M+ transactions/day) and multi-cloud infrastructure.

Contact: sumantamukhopadhyaywork@gmail.com · Book a call: https://calendar.app.google/fpARv4QHsYCLMo3a8

## Services
- [Fractional CTO](https://asksumanta.com/fractional-cto/): Part-time, senior technology leadership. A fractional CTO for strategy, architecture, hiring and board reporting, from first AI product to scale. US & UAE.
- [AI & LLM architecture](https://asksumanta.com/ai-architect/): AI and LLM architecture that ships: production RAG and GraphRAG, LangGraph agents, MCP, LLM evaluation and private on-prem models. Strategy to production.
- [Ontology & knowledge graphs](https://asksumanta.com/ontology-knowledge-graph/): Ontology engineering and knowledge graph consulting: shared business semantics, entity resolution, semantic layers and GraphRAG that make data and AI agree.
- [Healthcare data architecture](https://asksumanta.com/healthcare-data-architecture/): Healthcare data architecture consulting: HL7 FHIR interoperability, OMOP CDM and OHDSI research platforms, HIPAA-aligned cloud and clinical AI with guardrails.
- [Technical due diligence](https://asksumanta.com/technical-due-diligence/): Independent technical and AI due diligence for VC, PE and corporate investors: architecture, code, team, security, scalability and a value-creation plan.
- [Fractional CTO in the UAE](https://asksumanta.com/uae/): Fractional CTO and AI consultant for Dubai, Abu Dhabi and the GCC: AI strategy, data platforms and cloud, built for UAE PDPL, DIFC, ADGM and data residency.

## Insights
- [Architecture decision records: the habit I bring to every engagement](https://asksumanta.com/insights/architecture-decision-records-fractional-cto/): Architecture decision records turn tribal knowledge into a searchable history. How I use ADRs as a fractional CTO to speed up decisions and hand over cleanly.
- [LLM observability with OpenTelemetry: what to trace, what to leave out, and why it matters](https://asksumanta.com/insights/llm-observability-opentelemetry-genai/): OpenTelemetry's GenAI conventions give a standard way to trace LLM calls, tokens and tool use. What to capture, what to keep out, and how I set it up.
- [Idempotency for payments and orders: how to never charge a customer twice](https://asksumanta.com/insights/idempotent-payments-order-pipelines/): Retries are inevitable, double charges are not. How I design idempotent payment and order pipelines with idempotency keys, the outbox pattern and safe consumers.
- [Kubernetes FinOps in 2026: scale to zero, resize in place, and know who pays](https://asksumanta.com/insights/kubernetes-finops-scale-to-zero/): Kubernetes 1.36 and 1.37 added in-place pod resize and HPA scale-to-zero. A practical FinOps playbook for cutting cluster cost without hurting reliability.
- [Hybrid search for RAG in MongoDB: when to use $rankFusion, and when $scoreFusion](https://asksumanta.com/insights/mongodb-hybrid-search-rag/): Vector search alone misses exact terms. How I use MongoDB's $rankFusion and $scoreFusion to combine vector and full-text retrieval for RAG, and how to tune them.
- [UAE PDPL and AI in 2026: designing for a law whose detailed rules aren't written yet](https://asksumanta.com/insights/uae-pdpl-ai-architecture-2026/): The UAE PDPL is in force but key executive regulations are reportedly still unpublished. How I design AI and data platforms across federal, DIFC and ADGM regimes.
- [September 2026 briefing: GPUs get smarter scheduling, idle workloads scale to zero, and observability grows up](https://asksumanta.com/insights/briefing-2026-09/): September 2026 for AI and platform teams: Kubernetes v1.37 scale to zero, DRA and gang scheduling for GPUs, OpenTelemetry gains and FHIR API deadlines.
- [August 2026 briefing: Kubernetes 1.37, the new MCP roadmap and AI transparency rules go live](https://asksumanta.com/insights/briefing-2026-08/): August 2026 for AI and platform teams: Kubernetes v1.37 and Pod Certificates, the new MCP roadmap, OpenTelemetry updates and EU AI Act transparency rules.
- [July 2026 briefing: MCP goes stateless, the AI Act moves its deadlines, and the UAE gets easier access to AI chips](https://asksumanta.com/insights/briefing-2026-07/): July 2026 for architects: the stateless MCP 2026-07-28 spec goes GA, the EU AI Act Omnibus takes effect, the US eases AI chip exports to the UAE, and etcd 3.7.
- [June 2026 briefing: agents get enterprise identity, telemetry gets columnar, and the FDA codifies change control](https://asksumanta.com/insights/briefing-2026-06/): June 2026 for architects: MCP Enterprise-Managed Authorization goes stable, stateless SDK betas, OTel-Arrow benchmarks and an FDA rule for AI imaging.
- [May 2026 briefing: MCP goes stateless, OpenTelemetry graduates, and the EU agrees to move the AI Act deadlines](https://asksumanta.com/insights/briefing-2026-05/): May 2026 for architects: the MCP 2026-07-28 release candidate goes stateless, OpenTelemetry graduates, GenAI telemetry matures and the EU agrees AI Act delays.
- [April 2026 briefing: Kubernetes 1.36 hardens the platform, open models get a real licence, and FHIR reaches prior authorisation](https://asksumanta.com/insights/briefing-2026-04/): April 2026 for architects: Kubernetes v1.36 security graduations, Gateway API v1.5, Gemma 4 under Apache 2.0, Claude Opus 4.7 and a CMS FHIR proposal.
- [Securing MCP servers for enterprise AI agents: an architect's checklist](https://asksumanta.com/insights/securing-mcp-servers-checklist/): A practical checklist for running Model Context Protocol servers in production: token audience, confused deputy, least privilege, gateways, logging and prompt injection.
- [The EU AI Act after the Digital Omnibus: what actually changes for your AI roadmap](https://asksumanta.com/insights/eu-ai-act-digital-omnibus-roadmap/): The Digital Omnibus pushed EU AI Act high-risk deadlines to December 2027 and August 2028. What moved, what didn't, and how I'd adjust an AI roadmap now.
- [Running private LLMs on your own hardware: notes from the bench](https://asksumanta.com/insights/private-llm-on-prem/): Notes on private, on-prem LLMs for regulated data: model sizing, quantisation, LoRA fine-tuning, routing between local and hosted models, and an AI gateway.
- [FHIR to OMOP: a practical architecture for healthcare data](https://asksumanta.com/insights/fhir-to-omop-architecture/): How FHIR and OMOP CDM fit together: a reference pipeline from clinical sources through terminology mapping to OHDSI cohorts, with de-identification and HIPAA.
- [From RAG demo to production: a checklist](https://asksumanta.com/insights/rag-to-production-checklist/): A practitioner's checklist for taking RAG from demo to production: retrieval quality, evaluation, guardrails, permissions, cost per query and rollout.
- [Ontology vs knowledge graph vs semantic layer: what's the difference, and which do you need?](https://asksumanta.com/insights/ontology-vs-knowledge-graph-vs-semantic-layer/): Clear definitions of ontologies, knowledge graphs and semantic layers, how they fit together, when to use each, and how they make LLMs and RAG more accurate.
- [When do you need a fractional CTO? (And when you don't)](https://asksumanta.com/insights/when-do-you-need-a-fractional-cto/): Signs you need a fractional CTO, how it compares with interim, full-time and agency options, what the first 90 days look like, and how a clean handover works.
